Clarity.justification: The paper is well-structured with clear sections (Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Methodology, Experimental Setup, Results, Discussion, Conclusion). Ideas are articulated logically, with explicit hypotheses (h-e1, h-m1), success criteria, and tables/equations. Minor issues include repetitive emphasis on limitations and some overly detailed subsections that could be condensed.

Novelty.justification: The composite Q(D) metric integrates four standard components (deduplication, diversity, perplexity, efficiency) and validates them against information density proxies. While the controlled fractional factorial design on C4 subsets and emphasis on scaling-law integration are contributions, the individual components and information-theoretic proxies (entropy, n-gram redundancy, semantic diversity) are drawn from prior work (e.g., GPT-3 dedup, The Pile diversity, Shannon entropy). No fundamentally new algorithms or theoretical frameworks are introduced.

Soundness.justification: Major flaws exist: (1) h-e1 claims (r=0.78, R²=0.61, all components r>0.5, CV<10%) are presented as validated, yet the provided code only implements a failed h-m1 PoC (0.89% entropy reduction vs. 20% threshold; -20.84% Fisher change) at 0.005% planned scale with simplified length filtering. (2) No code or logs reproduce the reported h-e1 correlations or 12-subset results. (3) h-m1 gate fails explicitly, yet the paper treats h-e1 as a complete success while admitting downstream hypotheses are blocked. (4) Fisher information decrease contradicts predictions without resolution. Results are not reliable or consistent with the code.

Significance.justification: The paper addresses a relevant problem (data quality in scaling laws) and provides a measurement framework. However, the contribution is limited to correlation on web text only, with no causal validation, no compute-quality tradeoff curves, and no scale-invariance tests. The effect sizes claimed exceed predictions but rest on unverified results; practical impact is undermined by the documented failures and narrow scope (C4 English web text).

strengths: Clear articulation of hypotheses, gates, and reproducibility criteria
Honest discussion of limitations and failed PoC in Section 5
weaknesses: Experimental claims (h-e1 correlations) unsupported by provided code or logs
h-m1 failure at drastically reduced scale invalidates causal claims; results appear inconsistent or fabricated
